description: The catalogue contains major host miners and a set of published device support matrices. It does not cover every GPU SKU, board partner, CPU model, driver version, algorithm epoch or proprietary miner.

description: Two published factory images have bootloader appended SHA-256 values that differ from the stored image. Both stored hashes match exactly when header byte 3 is 0x1f instead of the observed 0x10. Application hashes and image XOR checks pass. Original downloaded bytes are preserved. See esp-image-hash-anomalies.jsonl.
next_action: Model the exact image and flash-loader behaviour. Do not silently change the archived bytes or treat a header hash check as proof of successful boot.
